description: During the CBRE account-pursuit-map run, Chase reported 'No live Dynamics CRM connector was available this session' and relied entirely on prior docs instead of live CRM data for engagement history and Realized-score inputs. The workflow file (workflows/account-pursuit-map/workflow.md, INITIALIZATION data sources table) explicitly specifies 'CRM via Chrome/M365 auth' as the access method — CRM access via Chrome was never attempted.
correction: Chase should have attempted CRM access via Chrome/M365 auth as the workflow directs before declaring the connector unavailable and falling back to prior documents.
failure_mode: Agent treated 'no CRM connector configured' as a hard stop instead of attempting the Chrome-based access method the workflow explicitly names, defaulting to a fallback path prematurely.
